result.stdout:
Usage: SvdGenerator <input.svd> <output_dir> [--check] [--force]
       SvdGenerator <input.svd> [<output_dir>] --list

Generates typed C++ peripheral headers for ARM Cortex-M targets
from a CMSIS-SVD file.

Files already in <output_dir> are replaced or removed only when
SvdGenerator wrote them; anything else is left alone.

Options:
  --check        Write nothing; exit with 3 when <output_dir> is not
                 what would be generated.
  --force        Overwrite a file of the same name that SvdGenerator
                 did not write.
  --list         Write nothing; print the files that would be generated,
                 one per line, for a build system that wants them as
                 the outputs of a rule.
  -h, --help     Show this help and exit.
  -v, --version  Show version and exit.

Exit codes: 0 success, 1 error, 2 refused to overwrite, 3 out of date.
